int_name: E HUNTING PARK AVE & I ST

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with residential row houses on both sides. While sidewalks and basic crosswalk markings are present, the large crossing distance and degraded pavement surface create a challenging environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians and affect vehicle handling.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner can block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style markings to make the crossing more visible to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show remaining crossing time to improve pedestrian decision-making.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized intersection in a residential area that lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, there are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps, forcing pedestrians to navigate the roadway without dedicated protection or guidance.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts as crossing points are not clearly defined.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicular signals, which do not provide dedicated walk intervals or countdowns for safe crossing.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped curb transitions creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility impairments or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style pavement markings to clearly delineate pedestrian crossing areas to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection that is signalized for vehicles but completely lacks pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the wide roadway and absence of designated crossing markings create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, meaning people walking have no clear indication of when it is safe to cross relative to vehicle signal phases.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block the visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide predictable crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance, improve sightlines, and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The street environment is primarily residential with a sidewalk on the left, but it lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control signs. The wide, unmarked roadway and sightline obstructions from overgrown vegetation at the corner increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the wide roadway without the protection or visibility of a marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to manage vehicle right-of-way at the junction.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation on the left corner blocks visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install bold, continental-style crosswalk markings to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim vegetation and restrict parking near the corner to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate vehicle movement and reduce speeds at the intersection.
